idea-plugin.name: Flutter Widget Wrapper
idea-plugin.description:
Add context-aware Flutter widget wrappers to the Alt+Enter intention menu. Wrap widgets without manually moving code, fixing indentation, or rebuilding constructors.
Includes built-in wrappers such as Align, AnimatedSize, Expanded, Flexible, GestureDetector, InkWell, Opacity, Positioned, SafeArea, SingleChildScrollView, SliverToBoxAdapter and Stack, plus optional presets (Consumer, BlocBuilder, Hero, …). Wrappers are shown only where they are valid; for example, Expanded and Flexible are offered only for direct children of Row, Column, or Flex, Positioned only for direct children of Stack, and inside slivers only sliver-aware wrappers.
Wrap from Alt+Enter, Surround With, postfix templates (Text('a').opacity) or a single searchable "Wrap with…" popup; wrap several selected siblings at once; replace one wrapper with another while keeping its child. Tab-stops (with choices) let you edit values right after wrapping, and every wrapper has a preview.
Create custom wrappers with a Dart editor, live preview and validation, import or export them as JSON, share them with your team through a .flutter-wrappers.json file in the project, or turn an existing widget into a reusable wrapper.
